name: Captain America (Infinity War)

abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Glancing: Sıyırma vuruşları kritik olamaz, %50 azalmış hasar verir ve saldırı yetenek doğruluğu %100 düşer.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

signatureAbility:
Leadership
An excellent leader, Captain America learns from his teammates gaining a unique effect, while Kinetically Charged, for each class represented on his team, excluding himself.
Mutant: [40 - 100]% chance on triggering a Special Attack to gain +1 Kinetic Potential.
Skill: [40 - 100]% chance whenever a Debuff is gained, Consume 1 Kinetic Potential to Purify it.
Science: [40 - 100]% chance on a Well-Timed Block to place a 10% Weakness Debuff on the Opponent for 10 seconds.
Cosmic: [40 - 100]% chance on a Well Timed Block to place an Armor Break Debuff on the Opponent, reducing their Armor by [305.56] for 10 seconds.
Tech: [40 - 100]% chance on a Well Timed Block to place a 25% Petrify Debuff on the Opponent for 10 seconds.
Mystic: [40 - 100]% chance to gain 1 Kinetic Potential each time a Buff Expires or is Nullified on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Kinetic Potential - Passive
content: Captain America's vibranium vambraces can store up to 5 Kinetic Potential charges. He will not generate any new Kinetic Potential while at this limit.
15% Chance when Struck to gain 1 Kinetic Potential(s).
50% Chance when Blocking to gain +1 Kinetic Potential. This chance increases to 100% on a Well Timed Block.
100% Chance when Stunned to gain +1 Kinetic Potential.
Kinetic Potential falls off over time, falling off faster the longer its been since it last increased.

abilitySections.title: Kinetically Charged - Passive
content: As long as Cap has at least 1 Kinetic Potential, he is considered to be Kinetically Charged, and gains the following bonuses as Passive effects:
+[916.67] Physical Resistance
+[916.67] Energy Resistance
100% chance to Nullify all Unstoppable Buffs when striking the Opponent.
+30% chance to cause Opponent's attacks to Glance. This chance increases by 100% against Mystic Champions.

abilitySections.title: When Charging a Heavy Attack
content: Beginning to charge a Heavy Attack grants a Passive Fury granting +[4,986.5] Attack per Kinetic Potential, lasting for 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: After any special Attack, Cap consumes all Kinetic Potential.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [2,493.25] Direct Damage over 3.5 seconds.
Reduces Opponent's Defensive Ability Accuracy by 100% if Kinetically Charged.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% chance to Stun for 1 second(s).
Each Kinetic Potential charge grants +[4,986.5] Attack and +0.5 second(s) Stun Duration.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: If Kinetically Charged gain +[9,973] Attack for each different Class on Cap's team, not including himself, up to 2 Classes.
Gain 1 Non-Consumable Kinetic Potential charge which lasts 30 seconds.
